descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S19 「时钟错的设备：之前记录的日期、第 2 天的状态和 37 h 的状态都跟着服务器」 Device with the wrong clock: prior note date, day-2 state and 37 h state follow the server

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U14 Every time rule in TC-13 (12/18/36 h windows, 'tomorrow', a prior note's default date) uses the server clock. A device with a wrong clock shows the same state as any other device.（UAT 3.8；TFA-94699 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Two devices on the same e2e-fresh-* account from freshAccount() on the local stack. Device A is normal; device B's clock is set 2 days ahead. Phones run a debug build bundled for the local stack: Android with adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 as in android-lane.ts, and iOS as an Xcode debug build whose Convex URL is the Mac's …

When On device B, paste a prior note with the date label empty and press Save & Extract, then save pre-round vitals. Then open the chart on device A and on device B, before and after the 20 h and 37 h points

Then The prior note's default date and stored time are the server's day, not device B's. Both devices show the same day-2 and 37 h state. Nothing written from device B clears early or survives late

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8 + TFA-94699 AC 7. Main writes previousNotes[].addedAt, labsUpdatedAt and vitalsUpdatedAt from the device clock and defaults the date label to the device date (risk list)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
